$comment: The pin manifest. A build is in this repository iff a TRACKED file of Archipelago-CC names it; scripts/procgen/check-seedling-wasm-pins.mjs in that repo gates the FOUR-way agreement between this manifest, the .gitignore whitelist, what git actually tracks here, and the build names that repo’s tracked files actually spell. Every build directory carries exactly four files. `js`/`wasm` are the AUTHORITY on the payload filenames — they do not always match the directory name.

builds.name: seedling_bot_ap_p4b
namedBy: scripts/procgen/verify-seedling-bot-differential.mjs (SEEDLING_PAGE default; PAGE_BASE is now read out of game.html)
builds.note: Phase 4b — THE bot build since 2026-08-19, when it absorbed everything seedling_bot_ap named. Its bridge surface is a strict superset of that build's eight verbs (it adds botForgeSaveStamp, botLevelSet, botLoadLevels). The retirement was EARNED by measurement, not assumed: the R8 tape gate (verify-seedling-bot-differential.mjs --win --only=<the 20 r8-* tapes>, comparing against seedling_bot_ap's OWN oracle recordings) read 534 PASS / 0 FAIL / 67 SKIP on both builds, run back to back with nothing edited in between; all 602 check lines agree in order and in text but for 13, each a free-running clock whose control arm — the same build re-run — moved at least as far. No expectation, tape or battery byte moved.
